WITH quantiles AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 1 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q1_cog,
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 2 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q2_cog,
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 3 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q3_cog
    FROM (
        SELECT cognitive_score,

    ) ranked
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        Q1_cog, Q2_cog, Q3_cog,
        (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as IQR,
        Q1_cog - 1.5 * (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as lower_bound_cog,
        Q3_cog + 1.5 * (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as upper_bound_cog
    FROM quantiles
),
rxn_quantiles AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 1 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q1_rxn,
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 2 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q2_rxn,
        AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 3 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q3_rxn
    FROM (
        SELECT reaction_ms, 
               CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) * 4.0 / 27.0) as percentile
        FROM measurements
    ) ranked
),
rxn_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        Q1_rxn, Q2_rxn, Q3_rxn,
        (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as IQR,
        Q1_rxn - 1.5 * (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as lower_bound_rxn,
        Q3_rxn + 1.5 * (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as upper_bound_rxn
    FROM rxn_quantiles
),
outliers AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM measurements m
    CROSS JOIN bounds b
    CROSS JOIN rxn_bounds r
    WHERE m.cognitive_score < b.lower_bound_cog 
       OR m.cognitive_score > b.upper_bound_cog
       OR m.reaction_ms < r.lower_bound_rxn
       OR m.reaction_ms > r.upper_bound_rxn
)
SELECT * FROM outliers;

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m
CROSS JOIN (
   WITH quantiles AS (
        SELECT 
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 1 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q1_cog,
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 2 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q2_cog,
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 3 THEN cognitive_score END) as Q3_cog
        FROM (
            SELECT cognitive_score, 
                   CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) * 4.0 / 27.0) as percentile
            FROM measurements
        ) ranked
    ),
    bounds AS (
        SELECT
            Q1_cog, Q2_cog, Q3_cog,
            (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as IQR,
            Q1_cog - 1.5 * (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as lower_bound_cog,
            Q3_cog + 1.5 * (Q3_cog - Q1_cog) as upper_bound_cog
        FROM quantiles
    ),
    rxn_quantiles AS (
        SELECT 
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 1 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q1_rxn,
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 2 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q2_rxn,
            AVG(CASE WHEN percentile = 3 THEN reaction_ms END) as Q3_rxn
        FROM (
            SELECT reaction_ms, 
                   CEIL(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) * 4.0 / 27.0) as percentile
            FROM measurements
        ) ranked
    ),
    rxn_bounds AS (
        SELECT
            Q1_rxn, Q2_rxn, Q3_rxn,
            (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as IQR,
            Q1_rxn - 1.5 * (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as lower_bound_rxn,
            Q3_rxn + 1.5 * (Q3_rxn - Q1_rxn) as upper_bound_rxn
        FROM rxn_quantiles
    )
    SELECT lbb.Q1_cog as Q1_cog, lbb.Q2_cog as Q2_cog, lbb.Q3_cog as Q3_cog, 
           lbb.IQR, lbb.lower_bound_cog, lbb.upper_bound_cog,
           rbb.Q1_rxn as Q1_rxn, rbb.Q2_rxn as Q2_rxn, rbb.Q3_rxn as Q3_rxn,
           rbb.IQR as IQR_rxn, rbb.lower_bound_rxn, rbb.upper_bound_rxn
    FROM bounds lbb, rxn_bounds rbb
) AS bounds
WHERE m.cognitive_score >= bounds.lower_bound_cog 
  AND m.cognitive_score <= bounds.upper_bound_cog
  AND m.reaction_ms >= bounds.lower_bound_rxn
  AND m.reaction_ms <= bounds.upper_bound_rxn
;
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog, 
       MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog,
       MIN(reaction_ms) as min_rxn,
       MAX(reaction_ms) as max_rxn,
       AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
       AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_rxn
FROM cleaned_measurements;
SELECT * FROM cleaned_measurements ORDER BY recorded_at LIMIT 10;
